text:
sam: FYI ACME trial hitting client-side timeouts and occasional 429s. POC uses Python SDK from a corporate CI behind a firewall. Anyone free to swarm?

acme-bob: seeing ReadTimeout and sometimes ECONNRESET. Local dev box can curl ok, CI fails. HTTP_PROXY is set in their runner.

jen: which SDK version? can you paste the minimal error/log and the request id if present?

acme-bob: sdk 1.2.2. stacktrace snippet: `requests.exceptions.ReadTimeout: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='api.redwood.inference', port=443): Read timed out.` Retry attempts 2. No request id in logs. headers show `Via: corporate-proxy` and `Proxy-Connection: keep-alive`.

alex: two quick things — (1) CI proxy often terminates long-lived TLS streams (streaming + long timeouts). (2) retries without backoff can trigger 429s from our edge.

nidhi: recommended quick fixes to try: increase client timeout, enable exponential backoff, set NO_PROXY for internal endpoints. Also ask the customer to run a curl test through their proxy to inspect TLS.

sam: can you paste the env from the CI job? especially HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/NO_PROXY.

acme-bob: env excerpt: `HTTP_PROXY=http://corp-proxy.corp:8080`, `HTTPS_PROXY=http://corp-proxy.corp:8080`, no NO_PROXY set.

alex: try adding NO_PROXY=api.redwood.inference,localhost and increase SDK request timeout to 30s. Example python config:```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="...", timeout=30, retries=5, backoff="exponential")
resp = client.generate("...")
```

nidhi: also tune retry/backoff so you don't retry immediately on 429. use jittered exponential backoff. we have a recommended policy: 100ms * 2^attempt + uniform(0,100ms).

jen: for debugging, run:```bash
curl -v -x http://corp-proxy.corp:8080 https://api.redwood.inference/v1/health
```look at the TLS handshake and server cert chain. If the proxy does TLS interception you'll see a company cert.

alex: if they do TLS intercept (corporate MITM) the SDK may fail streaming or chunked responses. Workarounds: (A) allow direct egress to our endpoints from CI or (B) add proxy CA to CI trust store, or (C) run the POC in a dedicated/private deployment (we can discuss enterprise options).

acme-bob: quick test: curl via proxy shows corporate cert chain. we can add CA but need security approval — that'll take time.

sam: ok plan: (1) ACME try NO_PROXY + increased timeout + backoff in CI. (2) if same, we schedule a 30m debug call — please capture `curl -v` output and a failing request id if present. (3) sales will surface dedicated/private deployment with security for longer term if they can't allow direct egress.

deploy-bot: SDK 1.2.3 released with improved retry/backoff config and explicit `proxy_trust_store` option.

nidhi: heads-up on rate limits: if customer increases retries massively it can create a retry storm and make 429s worse. best to limit max retries and prefer longer backoff + jitter.

acme-bob: will try the NO_PROXY + timeout + upgrade to 1.2.3 and report back in ~1hr. thanks team.

sam: thanks — ping me if you want a remote debug session. :thumbsup:
